The '''Applied Medical Sciences Division''' was a division in the [[Military Medical Services]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[B'arud]] compiled a report on the lingering effects of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]]'s "madness waves" on [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who fought there.
